title: Agent Conflict Error (409)
description: 409 body for an agent write that conflicts with current state. Two families share it. (1) AGENT_ALREADY_EXISTS: an active agent with the same key already exists in the project (create, or unarchive after the key was taken); `details` names that agent. (2) Deletion refusals (AGENT_HAS_BUILDS, AGENT_DELETE_BLOCKED_TRACKING, or the closed code explaining why experiments block deletion): the agent can only be archived, so `can_archive` is true and `archive_url_template` is a SERVER-BUILT path template, never a value the client sent. The client substitutes its own agent id for the `{agent_id}` placeholder and POSTs to it.

error.description: Fixed phrase: "Agent already exists" or "Cannot delete agent".

error_code.description: Closed code, for example AGENT_ALREADY_EXISTS, AGENT_HAS_BUILDS or AGENT_DELETE_BLOCKED_TRACKING.

details.description: AGENT_ALREADY_EXISTS only: the active agent that holds the key, disclosed only to a caller who can read it.

can_archive.description: Deletion refusals only: the agent can be archived instead.

archive_url_template.description: Deletion refusals only: fixed server-built path template with an `{agent_id}` placeholder the client fills in. Not a resolved URL.

affected_experiments.description: Deletion refusals caused by experiments: experiments that reference the agent.

active_experiments.description: Deletion refusals caused by experiments: experiments with an active run.
